prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original background spectator sprite atlas for a native SNES office fighting game, transparent background.
Primary request: Create one impeccably aligned SIX COLUMN by TWELVE ROW pixel-art animation contact sheet, 1536x3072 if possible. Each cell is 256 pixels wide and 256 pixels high; a single small full-body person centered within each cell, identical ground baseline, no overlap. Use crisp, simple, charming 1990s hand-pixelled cartoon art with dark navy outlines, modest detail, warm skin tones. Final sprites will be reduced to 16x32 pixels; keep readable silhouettes and small facial features, no text.
Columns depict the SAME character at the SAME position and size: 1 relaxed neutral standing; 2 subtle conversational hand gesture; 3 flinch with hands near chest at a heavy impact; 4 hands to cheeks looking surprised; 5 excited leaning forward with raised hands at a super move; 6 both arms up celebrating a knockout. Feet never change position. No combat stances, no weapons.
Rows 1-4: Chilean Las Condes office building arrivals/onlookers in modern business casual: row1 man in muted blue suit with tan briefcase; row2 woman in ochre jacket with dark pants; row3 man in charcoal cardigan and pale shirt; row4 woman in muted burgundy blouse holding a small bag.
Rows 5-8: El Castillo outdoor party guests: row5 woman in warm rose dress; row6 man in teal shirt and tan trousers; row7 woman in gold top and navy skirt; row8 man in muted brown jacket and green trousers.
Rows 9-12: La Oficina coworkers shown from head to hips, seated behind desks that will be composited separately: row9 man pale blue shirt and dark hair; row10 woman mustard cardigan and dark hair; row11 man white shirt and navy vest; row12 woman muted red blouse. Their LOWER HALF stays empty transparent. Gestures above shoulders must fit cell.
Constraints: exact six-column twelve-row grid, same character identity across each row, all background genuinely transparent, NO grid lines, NO captions, NO furniture or scenery, NO licensed or recognizable commercial game characters, NO logos, no glow or effects. Restrained colors, background spectators clearly secondary to foreground fighters.
use: Original atlas; deterministic alpha crop, downsample and fixed existing-stage palette conversion only.
